newsitem.title: ROMANIA: SOCCER-BOGUSZ OWN GOAL GIVES STEAUA FIRST WIN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BOGUSZ OWN GOAL GIVES STEAUA FIRST WIN.

text.p: Steaua Bucharest collected their first European champions' league win on Wednesday -- courtesy of a late own goal.
Widzew Lodz defender Daniel Bogusz put through his own net in the 82nd minute to give Steaua a 1-0 victory.
The goal climaxed a dramatic second half during which Steaua's Larentiu Rosu and the Polish side's Miroslav Symkowiak hit the bar.
Steaua dominated much of the match but missed banned Adrian Ilie's inventive skills in midfield.
